paragraphs: Back to Center is a small conversation app for sorting through worries, decisions, frustrations, and overloaded thoughts. It keeps chat history in the browser and sends AI requests through a local Node server to DeepInfra. When DeepInfra cannot respond, a simpler rule-based responder is used. This is a thinking companion, not a therapist or emergency service.

The browser workspace includes searchable, renameable, pinnable, and duplicable chats, a pinned-only history filter, local chat deep-links and copyable local links, automatic recovery of an unfinished draft, reversible deletion from both history and the open chat, local conversation stats, adjustable text size, optional timestamp visibility, JSON backup, Markdown export, native sharing when supported, keyboard shortcuts, an on-demand connection check, an optional install-app prompt, a distraction-free focus mode with countdown and stopwatch timers, an optional night theme, message editing,…

Chats remain browser-local by default. After meaningful use, the app may offer an optional account prompt. Hosted accounts use Supabase Auth and HttpOnly access-token cookies; users can explicitly save selected chats to that account. No chat is uploaded during signup automatically. The local fallback account store is intended for local or small deployments and does not include email verification, password recovery, multi-factor authentication, or distributed sessions.
